data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 2488 reported a prior-year surplus (release) in the movement in the prior year's provision for claims outstanding of GBP 103.741m (2014), representing a c.9.4% release relative to opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 1,100.679m. The report attributes the prior year improvement to favourable claims development across aviation, marine, financial lines, property and inwards reinsurance together with relatively benign catastrophe experience; a significant prior year release relating to the World Trade Centre (September 2001) is also noted.
raw_causal_phrases: The prior year's net provision for claims outstanding generated a surplus for 2014 (2013: surplus) as detailed below:
Prior period reserve releases amounted to GBP 10.3 million (2013: GBP 29.8 million) due primarily to improvements within aviation, marine, financial lines, property and inwards reinsurance lines.
As a result of relatively benign catastrophe experience, Syndicate 2488's natural catastrophe related losses after reinsurance recoveries amounted to GBP 5.0 million (2013: GBP 6.4 million).
There was also a significant prior year reserve release relating to the World Trade Centre losses of September 2001.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: The 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note (page 26) is used as the primary source and explicitly states a surplus totalling GBP 103,741k for 2014. That note is headed as the prior year's 'net provision' which indicates these amounts may be net of reinsurance. No explicit gross-only prior year movement column (Insurance liabilities) was present in the movement note; therefore the movement figure used should be treated as net-of-reinsurance in source. There is some narrative elsewhere quoting a different (smaller) net release figure (text references GBP 10.3m) which may be an OCR/formatting discrepancy; the table total of GBP 103,741k was used. Opening reserves were taken from the Balance Sheet (claims outstanding, 2013 column).
